answer_2.quote: We report the win rate, length-controlled win rate, and response average length.

answer_3.quote: We adopt AlpacaEval2, to assess the models' instruction-following ability. AlpacaEval2 contains 805 questions, and uses GPT-4-Turbo to perform side-by-side comparisons...
